scope: Generic single-class insect detection, not six-species accuracy or full browser pipeline
inference: PyTorch FP32 RTX4050; RGB /255 letterbox114 640; full+320/50% tiles; per-view NMS .7, global .45

selection.policy: Validation precision >= 0.70, maximize recall; fallback maximum F0.5. No test selection.

limitations: Public source boxes are not independently expert verified and may omit tiny insects.
Filename sequence groups are not verified independent capture days or traps.
Held-out test was used for the earlier v1 report; it is not a new unseen field collection.
